name: Elite Dangerous

keyboard-diagnostic.note: Startup/authentication diagnostic for the installed Odyssey executable, with simulated head pose and no simulated controllers. No credentials or authentication arguments supplied. Stop at authentication failure; this does not validate VR mode, physical keyboard/mouse, or AVP playback.

summary.en: Connects to SteamVR and survives the 60-second diagnostic; the final frame is still the SteamVR waiting background. ED rendering, authentication and keyboard/mouse input are unverified.
summary.ja: SteamVR接続と60秒の診断継続を確認。最終画像は待機背景で、ゲーム描画・認証・入力は未確認。

known_issues.summary: Official launcher/authentication handoff and VR activation are unverified; do not fabricate tickets, copy tokens, or bypass authentication.
Anti-cheat status remains unknown; absence of filename matches is not proof of absence. Stop on explicit evidence.

WinHTTP proxy configuration and IP Helper routing queries currently return explicit unsupported errors; their causal role in the network initialization failure is unverified. No proxy, route, authentication or ownership success is fabricated.

The user explicitly waived the known intermittent D3D12 zero timestamp check blocker for continued diagnostics. It remains unresolved; no assertion was weakened and no stable full-check pass is claimed.

notes: The profile selects the installed Odyssey product explicitly; it does not install, update or alter game configuration.
Isolated harness roots do not make the original install or host filesystem read-only.
No real keyboard/mouse input, headset behavior, or playable status has been verified.

No adapter/proxy/route success was fabricated.

This does not implement WinHTTP proxy discovery or GetBestRoute.
